question: What happens when the smoke-colored form is always contemplated?
premises: dhūmra varṇaṃ sadā cintya states always contemplating smoke-colored form
trailokyaṃ cālayet states shaking triple world
inference: Always contemplating the smoke-colored form shakes the triple world.
uncertainties: identity of the contemplated form is not explicit
plain_english: Always contemplating the smoke-colored form shakes the triple world, O beloved.
